top_signals.title: McDonald's Billion-Dollar Plan; Cracker Barrel Gains on Forecast | Stock Movers
top_signals.summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- McDonald's (MCD) shares are moving on news the company's earmarking roughly $8.5 billion to help franchisees implement a multiyear plan to serve better food, improve service and make restaurants easier to run.
- Cracker Barrel (CBRL) shares are gaining after the restaurant chain provided an adjusted Ebitda forecast for fiscal 2027 that beat the average analyst estimate.
- KBHomes (KBH) shares are dropping after the homebuilder lowered the upper end of its housing revenue forecast for the full year. The company also cut its housing gross profit margin for 2026. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Thames Creditors Plan Revised Rescue Deal to Avert State Control
top_signals.summary: Thames Water’s senior creditors are preparing to write off more debt and put more money into the utility in a renewed effort to avoid the UK government taking temporary control.
